meta.notes: Source of truth for the MOCA Facebook posting pipeline. status = published | pending. fb_post_reminder.py reads this daily and pings Telegram when a pending post is due (or overdue), and warns when pending count <= pipeline_low_threshold so Claude generates the next 2 weeks. BIDI RULE (2026-07-05): every body line INCLUDING the hashtag line must start with a Hebrew word - Facebook sets each line's direction by its first strong character, so a line starting with MOCA / 5GB / #eSIM renders its Hebrew scrambled. English mid-line (eSIM, MOCA) is fine. Prefer '18 ש״ח' over '₪18' (currency sign next to a number can flip).

posts.title: פער מחירים
posts.body:
אותה חבילת eSIM ליפן:
ספק אחד, 140 ש״ח. ספק אחר, 35 ש״ח.
אותה דאטה, אותו יעד, פער של פי 4. 🤯
